exposure: fetal head circumference (FHC) measured on ultrasound between 32 and 36 weeks and 6 days gestation
ultrasound at 32-36 weeks and 6 days gestation
ultrasound within 7 days of a term birth
cohort: 60 pregnancies from January to December 2019, with singleton term neonates who received two ultrasounds, one at 32-36 weeks and 6 days gestation and a second within 7 days of a term birth
finding: The GAP method applied to an early third trimester ultrasound predicts birth head circumference with accuracy similar to an ultrasound performed seven days from delivery.
